text:
Run these from the repo root, each in its own terminal:

```bash
docker compose up -d                                         # 1. Qdrant (vector store) on :6333/:6334
dotnet run --project src/TaxWise.Api --launch-profile http   # 2. API on http://localhost:5080
dotnet build src/TaxWise.App -t:Run -f net10.0-maccatalyst   # 3. Desktop app (Mac Catalyst)
```

- Open Docker Desktop before step 1.
- Leave the API running while you use the app. When the app connects to it, its status dot turns green.
- If answers come back empty, the Qdrant collection may be empty. Fill it with `dotnet run --project src/TaxWise.Ingestion -- --spot-check`.
- Your API keys (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `Voyage:ApiKey`) should already be saved in user-secrets from earlier phases.

This is all in the **Run** section of `README.md`.
